failed_attempt.failure_boundary: One treatment runner exited after the initial metric window, before its first scheduled intervention and before any scientific or model outcome was computed.
failed_attempt.retention: The entire failed attempt remains immutable operational evidence and is forbidden from model input.

repair.code_scope: Preserve captured runner output on nonzero subprocess exit.
